title: Dating App Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template to request your personal data from Tinder, Bumble, Hinge and other dating apps. Protect your privacy with our free letter.
description: Use this comprehensive letter template to formally request access to your personal data from dating platforms like Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, and Grindr. Includes proper legal language and step-by-step guidance for exercising your privacy rights under GDPR and CCPA.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:
[Your Full Name]
[Your Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]
[Your Email Address]
[Your Phone Number]

[Date]

[Dating App Company Name]
Data Protection Officer
[Company Address]

Subject: Data Access Request Under [GDPR/CCPA] - Account: [Your Username/Email]

sections.heading: Opening Statement
sections.content:
Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to formally request access to all personal data you hold about me under my rights as outlined in [the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Article 15 / the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Section 1798.110].

I am a user of your [dating app name] service and my account is associated with the following information:
- Username: [Your Username]
- Email Address: [Your Email]
- Phone Number: [Your Phone Number]
- Account Creation Date (if known): [Date]

sections.heading: Specific Data Request
sections.content:
I hereby request access to all personal data you process about me, including but not limited to:

• Profile information (photos, bio, preferences, demographics)
• Location data and geolocation history
• Messaging history and communications
• Match history and interaction data
• Usage analytics and behavioral data
• Device information and IP addresses
• Third-party data sources and integrations
• Algorithm scoring and recommendation data
• Payment and subscription information
• Any data shared with or received from third parties
• Data retention schedules and deletion dates
• Records of data processing activities involving my information

sections.heading: Legal Rights Reference
sections.content:
Under [GDPR/CCPA], I have the right to:

1. Receive confirmation of whether you process my personal data
2. Access the personal data you hold about me
3. Receive information about the purposes of processing
4. Know the categories of personal data concerned
5. Understand who my data has been shared with
6. Know how long my data will be stored
7. Receive my data in a structured, machine-readable format

I request that you provide this information within the legally required timeframe of [30 days under GDPR / 45 days under CCPA].

sections.heading: Identity Verification
sections.content:
To verify my identity, I am providing the following information:

• Full Name: [Your Full Name]
• Email associated with account: [Your Email]
• Phone number associated with account: [Your Phone Number]
• Last known location when using the app: [City, State]
• Approximate account creation date: [Date]

If you require additional verification, please contact me using the information provided above. I am happy to provide reasonable proof of identity while maintaining my privacy and security.

sections.heading: Delivery Instructions
sections.content:
Please provide the requested information in a secure, encrypted format via email to [Your Email Address]. If the data is extensive, please provide it in multiple files or via a secure download link with appropriate access controls.

I prefer to receive the data in commonly readable formats such as PDF, CSV, or JSON. Please ensure that any files are virus-scanned and password-protected if containing sensitive information.

sections.heading: Closing Statement
sections.content:
I expect a response within the legally mandated timeframe. If you cannot comply with this request or need additional time, please provide written explanation of the delay and expected completion date.

If you need clarification on any aspect of this request, please contact me promptly. I reserve the right to escalate this matter to the relevant data protection authority if my request is not handled appropriately.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]
